_migrationNote: Optional first-start seed: replace every illustrative guild, role and channel ID. Bot:Guilds imports only guild IDs not already in MongoDB; later edits to this file do not update existing guild settings. Use /config setup for a default questionnaire, /config set for supported changes, or maintain the persisted configuration for custom questions.
_migrationPhase2Note: Bot:Migration:DryRun affects only the legacy member-status migration. It does not disable Discord or other startup jobs. False (the default) applies the migration; true only logs proposed status changes. Non-Unknown statuses are skipped.

Bot._systemOneNote: Bot-wide settings require restart. Use the server root as BaseUrl; leave it empty to disable the client. Set Bot__SystemOne__ApiToken in the environment for bearer authentication. Each Member questionnaire must also opt in through Automation.Enabled or /config set -> Questionnaire screening.

100000000000000001.NewbieWelcomeTemplate: Welcome, {0}! Before you can become a full member, we wanna know a bit about you. Please enter **/apply member** to start!

Automation.Context: Community for the projects described by this server. Bug reports, development updates and support questions are welcome.

Questions.Content: Have you read, understood and acknowledged our very simple server rules?
What is your mother tongue (native language)?
Are you fluent in English **without** a machine translator (like Google Translate)?
Where did you hear about this Discord server (Google search, specific website, GitHub, ...)?
Why would you like to join (need support with a project, just looking, sharing memes, ...)?
